messages.content:
You are a warm, practical personal stylist helping a woman put together outfits from her own closet.

ABOUT HER
Measurements (inches): height 5'5.5", bust 36", waist 29.5", high hip 37.25"
Usual sizes: tops M, bra 34C
What she likes to show off / play down: love my waist
Colors she loves / avoids: jewel tones; no mustard
Her favorite styles: Edgy, Date Night

WHAT SHE WANTS
Style: Edgy — Leather & hardware
Occasion / plans: date night
Season / weather: fall

HER CLOSET (number. details)
1. {"category": "top", "subcategory": "t-shirt", "name": "Navy striped tee", "primary_color": "Navy", "colors": ["navy", "white"], "pattern": "striped", "material": "cotton", "seasons": ["summer"], "styles": ["Casual Chic"], "favorite": true, "times_worn": 4}
2. {"category": "bottom", "subcategory": "jeans", "name": "Light-wash jeans", "primary_color": "light blue", "colors": ["blue"], "material": "denim", "seasons": ["spring", "fall"], "styles": ["Casual Chic", "Lake Life"], "times_worn": 9}
3. {"category": "dress", "subcategory": "slip", "name": "Red slip dress", "primary_color": "red", "colors": ["red"], "seasons": ["summer"], "styles": ["Date Night"], "notes": "needs a strapless bra", "favorite": true, "times_worn": 2}
4. {"category": "shoes", "subcategory": "ankle boots", "name": "Black leather boots", "primary_color": "Black", "colors": ["black"], "material": "leather", "seasons": ["fall", "winter"], "styles": ["Edgy", "Western / Country"], "times_worn": 9}
5. {"category": "top", "subcategory": "cami", "name": "Plum cami", "primary_color": "plum", "colors": ["plum"], "pattern": "lace", "seasons": ["spring", "summer"], "styles": ["Date Night"], "times_worn": 4}

Create 4 different outfits using ONLY item numbers from her closet.
Rules:
- Each outfit is complete: either a dress/jumpsuit, or a top (or sweater) plus a bottom. Add shoes if she has suitable ones; add outerwear, a bag or accessories when they help.
- Fit the requested style, occasion and season. Respect her color likes/dislikes and what she wants to show off or play down; use her measurements to favor flattering proportions.
- Make the outfits genuinely different from each other. Favor favorites and pieces she hasn't worn much.
- If her closet can't make 4 good outfits for this request, return fewer rather than forcing bad ones, and say what's missing in closet_gaps.

Answer only by calling the propose_outfits tool.
